card.text: New equal pay rules under the Canada Labour Code take effect

events.text: First, on October twentieth, new equal pay rules came into force under the Canada Labour Code.

card.text: New equal pay rules under the Canada Labour Code take effect

events.text: Those rules say a federally regulated employer can't pay someone a lower rate just because they're part time or temporary, when they do substantially the same work as someone full time in the same place.

events.text: And how does it define harassment?
